metadata.question: Does the nighttime light intensity in Aleppo, Syria decrease in 2016 compared to 2012?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Aleppo, Syria (approximately 36.2°N, 37.1°E) - Time periods: 2012 and 2016 (full years for comparison) - Collection: VIIRS daily NTL data (NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1 or NASA/VIIRS/002/VNP46A2) - Note: VIIRS data starts from 2012, so we should have data for both years 2. Masking strategy: - For nighttime lights, we want to use the actual NTL values - Quality filtering may be needed but not cloud masking per se - Focus on DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m or Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error: - Valid decrease would show positive NTL values in both years with 2016 < 2012 - C1: If no images found in either year - C2: If images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: If calculations return None/NaN or unrealistic values - A: If 2016 NTL < 2012 NTL (decrease confirmed) - B: If 2016 NTL >= 2012 NTL (no decrease) ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point([37.1, 36.2]) region = aleppo.buffer(5000) # 5km radius around Aleppo center # 2. Data Acquisition for 2012 col_2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') \ .filterBounds(region) \ .filterDate('2012-01-01', '2012-12-31') \ .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m') size_2012 = col_2012.size().getInfo() print(f"2012 Images: {size_2012}") if size_2012 == 0: # Try NASA version col_2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/VIIRS/002/VNP46A2') \ .filterBounds(region) \ .filterDate('2012-01-01', '2012-12-31') \ .select('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL') size_2012 = col_2012.size().getInfo() print(f"2012 Images (NASA): {size_2012}") if size_2012 == 0: print("No data for 2012") print("C1") exit() # 3. Data Acquisition for 2016 col_2016 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') \ .filterBounds(region) \ .filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31') \ .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m') size_2016 = col_2016.size().getInfo() print(f"2016 Images: {size_2016}") if size_2016 == 0: print("No data for 2016") print("C1") exit() # 4. Calculate mean composites mean_2012 = col_2012.mean() mean_2016 = col_2016.mean() # 5. Check pixel counts count_2012 = mean_2012.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=region, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).values().getInfo()[0] count_2016 = mean_2016.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=region, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).values().getInfo()[0] print(f"2012 Valid Pixels: {int(count_2012)}") print(f"2016 Valid Pixels: {int(count_2016)}") if count_2012 == 0 or count_2016 == 0: print("No valid pixels after processing") print("C2") exit() # 6. Calculate mean NTL intensity ntl_2012 = mean_2012.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=region, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).values().getInfo()[0] ntl_2016 = mean_2016.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=region, scale=500, maxPixels=1e9 ).values().getInfo()[0] print(f"2012 Mean NTL: {ntl_2012:.4f}") print(f"2016 Mean NTL: {ntl_2016:.4f}") # 7. Validation & Final Answer if ntl_2012 is None or ntl_2016 is None: print("Calculation failed") print("C3") elif ntl_2016 < ntl_2012: decrease_pct = ((ntl_2012 - ntl_2016) / ntl_2012) * 100 print(f"Decrease: {decrease_pct:.1f}%") print("A") else: print("No decrease detected") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
aleppo = ee.Geometry.Point([37.1, 36.2])
region = aleppo.buffer(5000)  # 5km radius around Aleppo center

# 2. Data Acquisition for 2012
col_2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') \
    .filterBounds(region) \
    .filterDate('2012-01-01', '2012-12-31') \
    .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m')

size_2012 = col_2012.size().getInfo()
print(f"2012 Images: {size_2012}")

if size_2012 == 0:
    # Try NASA version
    col_2012 = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/VIIRS/002/VNP46A2') \
        .filterBounds(region) \
        .filterDate('2012-01-01', '2012-12-31') \
        .select('Gap_Filled_DNB_BRDF_Corrected_NTL')
    size_2012 = col_2012.size().getInfo()
    print(f"2012 Images (NASA): {size_2012}")
    if size_2012 == 0:
        print("No data for 2012")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()

# 3. Data Acquisition for 2016
col_2016 = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/001/VNP46A1') \
    .filterBounds(region) \
    .filterDate('2016-01-01', '2016-12-31') \
    .select('DNB_At_Sensor_Radiance_500m')

size_2016 = col_2016.size().getInfo()
print(f"2016 Images: {size_2016}")

if size_2016 == 0:
    print("No data for 2016")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
    exit()

# 4. Calculate mean composites
mean_2012 = col_2012.mean()
mean_2016 = col_2016.mean()

# 5. Check pixel counts
count_2012 = mean_2012.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=region,
    scale=500,
    maxPixels=1e9
).values().getInfo()[0]

count_2016 = mean_2016.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
    geometry=region,
    scale=500,
    maxPixels=1e9
).values().getInfo()[0]

print(f"2012 Valid Pixels: {int(count_2012)}")
print(f"2016 Valid Pixels: {int(count_2016)}")

if count_2012 == 0 or count_2016 == 0:
    print("No valid pixels after processing")
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    exit()

# 6. Calculate mean NTL intensity
ntl_2012 = mean_2012.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=region,
    scale=500,
    maxPixels=1e9
).values().getInfo()[0]

ntl_2016 = mean_2016.reduceRegion(
    reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
    geometry=region,
    scale=500,
    maxPixels=1e9
).values().getInfo()[0]

print(f"2012 Mean NTL: {ntl_2012:.4f}")
print(f"2016 Mean NTL: {ntl_2016:.4f}")

# 7. Validation & Final Answer
if ntl_2012 is None or ntl_2016 is None:
    print("Calculation failed")
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif ntl_2016 < ntl_2012:
    decrease_pct = ((ntl_2012 - ntl_2016) / ntl_2012) * 100
    print(f"Decrease: {decrease_pct:.1f}%")
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("No decrease detected")
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
